latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Drivers’ Hours & WTD Infringement Coach (UK):

- Generates 1-page, driver-facing tacho/WTD infringement notes with friendly, professional language.
- Produces a corrective action plan including specific actions and a clear review date.
- Applies RAG escalation rules for severity and follow-up scheduling.
- Ensures all key inputs (driver ID, date range, infringements, sources) are validated, with prompts for missing data.
- Stays strictly evidence-based, focusing on facts and internal policy; avoids assumptions or legal advice.
